WITH item_town_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ili.order_item_id,
        c.town_city,
        AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_product_price,
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 
                THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost 
                ELSE NULL 
            END
        ) AS avg_cost_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
    JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        town_city,
        AVG(avg_product_price) AS avg_price,
        AVG(avg_cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM item_town_avg
    GROUP BY town_city
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio
    FROM town_avg
)
SELECT 
    t.town_city,
    t.avg_price,
    t.avg_ratio,
    t.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM town_avg t
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: When derived_total_cost is NULL or zero, the ratio for that line item is treated as NULL and excluded from averaging (following SQL's AVG semantics).
